svg.title: Happy birthday, Trap — Arcade's graffiti mural
svg.desc: 140 approved hand-painted covers by 140 people. Each painting includes its original birthday wish in its description.
svg.metadata: Snapshot 8293ad0adab0fd5a. Saved 2026-11-10T14:24:38.001Z. Original vector strokes; no external assets.

g.title: Fyy
g.desc: Trap, even though we don't know each other that well, I can tell that you're such a kind and thoughtful person. Thank you for always being around and for continuously helping Arcade, especially Fear and Esthell. Your time, effort, and willingness to help never go unnoticed, and I'm sure your presence means more than you realise. for all the good things you've done. May Allah protect your heart, grant you good health, and fill your days with barakah. I hope life treats you gently, and may you always be surrounded by people who appreciate your kindness as much as you deserve. جزاكِ اللهُ خيرًا

g.title: CocoLoco0
g.desc: Jazzzzz! Here's to another year of you becoming the wise old soul that you've always been! Fr tho, I've always thought you're much wiser beyond your years, having some perspective that you don't usually find at your age, and Ive always admired that. And even though we don't talk as much these days, I'm really glad we've managed to stay in touch, even if it's just occasionally. I am really so grateful to have you as a friend, Jazz. You truly deserve all the love and happiness in this world and then some! I'll always be rooting for you :)
